RootQuery.hbLlms: HbLlms
RootQuery.hbLlmsFull: HbLlms
RootQuery.hbRedirects: [HbRedirect!]
RootQuery.hbSeoSchema(uri: String): String
RootQuery.hbSeoSettings: HbSeoSettings
RootQuery.hbSitemap: [HbSitemapEntry!]
Page.seo: HbSeo
Post.seo: HbSeo
Category.seo: HbSeo
Tag.seo: HbSeo

type HbLlms {
  bytes: Int!
  content: String!
  updatedAt: String!
}

type HbRedirect {
  code: Int!
  databaseId: Int!
  from: String!
  note: String
  to: String
}

type HbSeo {
  canonical: String
  description: String
  isInSitemap: Boolean!
  isIndexed: Boolean!
  keywords: [String!]!
  ogDescription: String
  ogImage: String
  ogTitle: String
  ogType: String
  robots: String
  title: String
  twitterCard: String
  twitterImage: String
  twitterTitle: String
}

type HbSeoSettings {
  defaultDescription: String
  favicon: String
  ogImage: String
  separator: String
  siteTitle: String
  titleOrder: HbSeoTitleOrderEnum!
}

enum HbSeoTitleOrderEnum {
  PAGE_SITE
  SITE_PAGE
}

type HbSitemapEntry {
  databaseId: Int!
  lastmod: String
  loc: String!
  subtype: String!
  title: String
  type: String!
}
